newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise at auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices gained on increased overseas demand at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Brokers said buyers for Pakistan, Poland and Afghanistan operated strongly for most grades of tea on offer. Local blenders were also active in the market, pushing prices up.
Some 1.11 million kgs of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 47.25 taka per kg, 0.48 taka up from the previous sale.
The next auction will be on December 24 with an expected offer of 1.35 million kg. ($1 = 42.45 taka)
